description: Isolated, always-warm job that manages its own cron schedule in-process, bypassing Dagster's SchedulerDaemon entirely (its minute-granular tick evaluation is architectural, not a load artifact -- confirmed against the Dagster OSS scheduler source, which Dagster+'s control plane subclasses unchanged). Warms up once per bounded run (load a model, open connections), then fires tick_fn as a direct in-process function call at each precise scheduled instant -- never through Dagster's run-launching APIs, which is what makes each tick instant and keeps the process genuinely isolated (dedicated resources, not the shared code-location server). Pair with StreamingRunHealthSensorComponent, unmodified, for auto-restart.

outputs.description: Summary dict + one AssetMaterialization per scheduled tick (with measured drift against the scheduled instant)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Output asset name (also used by the paired health sensor's asset_selection).

schedule.label: Schedule
schedule.description: A cron string. Standard 5-field by default (e.g. '*/15 * * * *'). Evaluated by this component's own internal loop via croniter -- NOT a Dagster ScheduleDefinition, never handed to the SchedulerDaemon. Set second_precision: true for 6-field (seconds-leading) cron, e.g. '*/30 * * * * *' for every 30 seconds -- a granularity Dagster's native scheduler can never express at all.

second_precision.label: Second Precision
second_precision.description: Parse `schedule` as 6-field cron (seconds-leading) instead of standard 5-field.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York') the cron string is evaluated in.

warmup_fn.label: Warmup Function
warmup_fn.description: 'module.path:function_name', called ONCE per bounded run (not per tick) as `warmup_fn(context) -> Any`. Return value passed as warm_state to every tick_fn call in this run. Optional.

tick_fn.label: Tick Function
tick_fn.description: 'module.path:function_name', called once per precise scheduled tick as `tick_fn(context, warm_state, scheduled_time) -> Optional[dict]`, as a direct in-process function call -- never through Dagster's run-launching APIs.

max_seconds.label: Max Seconds
max_seconds.description: Bounded run duration. `null` = unbounded (runs until killed; health sensor auto-restarts). Bounded re-pays the warmup cost once per window, not once per tick.

max_ticks.label: Max Ticks
max_ticks.description: Optional cap on total ticks executed before exit (in addition to max_seconds).

catchup.label: Catchup
catchup.description: Default (false): if behind schedule, skip straight to the next FUTURE tick. true: execute every missed tick back-to-back (bounded by max_catchup_ticks).

max_catchup_ticks.label: Max Catchup Ticks
max_catchup_ticks.description: Safety cap on consecutive missed ticks executed back-to-back when catchup=true.

tick_error_handling.label: Tick Error Handling
tick_error_handling.description: 'continue' (default): a tick_fn exception is logged + reported as a failed-tick materialization, loop continues. 'raise': the exception fails the whole run immediately.

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Lineage Deps

name: Warm Scheduled Job
